title: Medtrum Nano / stop bolus gives error
symptom: When stopping an ongoing bolus, a pump unreachable alert is shown, even though the bolus was canceled by the user. The alert appears to be a connection problem message with three buttons, but the text says to check amounts.
cause: The error dialog for stopping a bolus incorrectly shows the same three buttons as a connection problem, and the message text is confusing. The underlying issue is that the driver returns an error when the user cancels the bolus, instead of returning success.
fix: The fix is to make the driver return success when the bolus is canceled by the user, as done in the Insight Driver. This was implemented in PR #4283.
evidence_quote: Fixed with #4283 (if the bolus was canceled by the user, it should should return success, it's done that way within Insight Driver).
